process.label: How we work
process.title: From idea to launch, and beyond.

steps.title: Talk
steps.body: Tell us about your business on WhatsApp, a call or our form. We'll recommend what you actually need, and what you don't.

steps.title: Design
steps.body: You see how your site will look before we write any code, and we refine it together.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: We build it mobile-first and test it on real phones. You get preview links along the way.

steps.title: Launch
steps.body: Your site goes live on your own domain, and we show your team how to run it.

steps.title: Grow
steps.body: After launch, we help you improve, add features and reach more customers as your business grows.

aboutPage.metaDescription: Big Ape Web is a web design and development agency building websites, online stores and web apps for businesses in Bangladesh and beyond.
aboutPage.label: About us
aboutPage.title: We're Big Ape Web.
aboutPage.subtitle: A web design and development agency that builds websites, online stores and web apps for businesses in Bangladesh and beyond.
story: Big Ape started as our founder's nickname, and it stuck. It's also a fair description of how we work: big on ambition, strong on the details, and friendly once you get to know us.
Our mascot peeks out of a browser window for a reason. Everything we make lives on the web, and we want it to stand out there.
We work with shops, brands, founders and couples who want more than a template: a website that looks premium, loads fast on any phone and actually brings in business.

values.title: Mobile first
values.body: Most of your customers are on their phones, so that's where we design first.

values.title: Built to sell
values.body: Every page has a job: to get a call, a message or an order.

values.title: Plain language
values.body: No jargon. You'll always know what we're doing and why.

values.title: In it for the long run
values.body: After launch, we help you improve and grow your site.

aboutPage.toolsBody: Modern, proven technology, chosen for speed and for how easy your site will be to run.
